# Claude Code — dotfiles repo

> For the general contribution workflow (pre-commit setup, dry-run, CI, worktrees, commit
> conventions), see [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). This file covers Claude-specific guidance.

## Before touching any file

1. `pre-commit run --all-files` — fix every finding before committing.
2. `chezmoi apply --dry-run --exclude=externals` — review the diff on the actual machine.
3. If `secrets = "bitwarden"`: ensure `bw` is unlocked and `BW_SESSION` is exported before
   running `chezmoi apply` (the kubeconfig template will fail otherwise).

## Generated files — never edit by hand

`~/.claude/settings.json` (the Bash permission allowlist) is generated by chezmoi from
`home/dot_claude/dot_claude/settings.json.tmpl` + `home/.chezmoidata/permissions.toml`.
To allow a new read-only command, add it to `permissions.toml` and run `chezmoi apply`.
Never edit `settings.json` directly. See the `chezmoi` skill for the full workflow.

## Template files

Files ending in `.tmpl` are rendered by chezmoi using Go templates. Access config data via
`{{ .profile }}`, `{{ .machine }}`, `{{ .display }}`, `{{ .secrets }}`, `{{ .chezmoi.os }}`.

The `{{ if ... }}` guards in `Brewfile.tmpl` and the run scripts are load-bearing — a missing
guard silently installs packages on the wrong machine type. Check `.chezmoiignore` and the
template conditionals before adding anything that should be gated.

## Skills

The `chezmoi` skill has repo-specific patterns for generated files, the `.chezmoiroot` layout,
and the `run_once_` / `run_onchange_` / `run_after_` script types. Load it before making
structural changes.

## Worktrees

Worktrees live at `.worktrees/<branch-name>`. Pre-consented — create without asking.
The global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` has the full worktree policy.
